atom.demo.1.0: Command handed over to you. Head to the north-east. EK14 and KY21 on their way.
atom.demo.1.1: Image updated. Edge north of the forest road.
atom.demo.2.0: Ahead of the head to the north-east, about 400 m away, dense spruce begins (Spruce Hill). The head is spreading towards it.
atom.demo.2.1: We are starting the line on the north flank. Escape route checked.
atom.demo.3.0: New smoke on the Dry Heath esker, about 150 m from the head. Cause not known.
atom.demo.3.1: A small flame seen on top of the esker.
atom.demo.4.0: The fires have joined. Water point W1 chosen, a long trip.
t4.water_state: The water here will last only about twenty more minutes.
atom.demo.5.0: The head is at the edge of the Spruce Hill spruce stand. Dense undergrowth, poor visibility.
atom.demo.6.0: Crown fire has started. We are withdrawing, embers seen 200–400 m ahead.
atom.demo.6.1: Thermal camera image saturated, no exact edge.
t4.ember_warning: Embers are coming over the esker to our side, keep an eye out.
f7.grid_record: Grid company control centre: the 110 kV power line east of the fire is still live. Switching the line off has been requested; notice of the switching will be given separately. Until then safety distances apply.
atom.demo.7.0: The crown fire has dropped into the Birch Creek birch stand, the surface fire continues. Requesting more units.
atom.demo.8.0: The helicopter is working the head. The drones have landed north of the road.
atom.demo.9.0: The wind has turned to the south-east, the north flank has become active towards Bear Lake.
atom.demo.9.1: Occupancy of the Lakeside Cottages is not known; the police have been asked to check.
f7.heli_line_clearance: HELI1: bucket runs to the head continue. The route goes around the 110 kV power line; we keep well clear of the conductors and do not drop water on the line.
rekindle.in_hand.ky21: KY21: Sector 3 under control. The wind has eased, no smoke visible on the south edge by the point of origin.
rekindle.in_hand.vpk: VOL1: The south edge by the point of origin has calmed down, no open fire visible. The line holds.
rekindle.in_hand.log: Situation log: sector L3 (south of the point of origin) under control, reported by KY21.
atom.demo.10.0: Sector 2 under control, sector 1 nearly. The wind is easing and turning, the north edge is only advancing slowly as a low surface fire, the smoke is decreasing.
rekindle.objection: At the edge by the point of origin, stumps and logging slash could still be smouldering under the surface. If the wind turns, it can flare up again. We should check with a thermal camera before we leave.
rekindle.overruled: There is no one to spare for a check. The sector is under control, we move to L1.
atom.demo.11.0: The situation is calm. A release is being planned for sector 1.
t4.private_doubt: We were ordered off the south edge by the point of origin. I am not at all sure the old edge will hold if the wind turns.
atom.demo.12.0: Open fire and smoke south-east of the point of origin, outside the old south edge, about 120 m from the point of origin. Not on the map. The old edge has flared up again since the wind turned west-north-west.
atom.demo.12.1: SPOT, second pass at 17.10: the new fire south-east of the point of origin is about 0.5–1 ha (sector L3, south-east of the point of origin), surface fire in the litter, flames under a metre. The edge is spreading east-south-east, roughly 3 m/min. The smoke drifts east-south-east.
atom.demo.13.0: The new front is spreading east along the old south edge. Service road R2 is still passable; the new front is a good kilometre from the road. Service road R2 is the tankers' water-shuttle route.
atom.demo.14.0: The region requests KY21 for another fire.
atom.demo.15.0: North of the road the fire is burning deep in the humus layer and the stump roots, 20–40 cm down. The water does not soak into the dry humus. Wetting agent is being considered.
atom.demo.16.0: New units arriving. The bridge limits the route for heavy vehicles.
atom.demo.17.0: The gusts from the north-west have strengthened. Movement towards Bay Village.
atom.demo.17.1: The head is spreading south-east towards Bay Village.
atom.demo.18.0: The north edge has flared up again; new smoke and flames seen east of the track.
atom.demo.18.1: Our own line holds, no change.
atom.demo.contradiction.reconciling: Something is smoking east of the track, not our sector.
atom.demo.19.0: Crew in the field for over seven hours. Rotation under way.
atom.demo.19.1: The south-east front is heading for service road R2. If the fire reaches the road, the water-shuttle route is cut.
atom.demo.19.2: New smoke and flames west of the point of origin, outside the old west edge, about 130 m from the point of origin. The old edge has flared up again.
atom.demo.19.3: SPOT, second pass at 19.30: the new fire west of the point of origin is about 0.3 ha, surface fire in the litter, flames under a metre. The smoke drifts south-east.
atom.demo.20.0: The night organisation takes over at 20.00. Situation recorded.
atom.demo.20.1: The rekindle west of the point of origin is still burning, flames visible. The smoke drifts south-east towards Moss Bog.
